chunks: Yūnus, from al-Muʿallā, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when a drinker of wine was brought to him, would strike him once; then if he was brought a second time, he would strike him; then if he was brought a third time, he would strike his neck.

key_terms.شَارِبِ ٱلْخَمْرِ: a person who drinks wine or intoxicating drink
key_terms.ضَرَبَ عُنُقَهُ: he struck his neck, meaning execution
key_terms.ضَرَبَهُ: he struck him as a prescribed punishment

ai.seo_question: What punishment is mentioned in hadith for repeatedly drinking wine?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling attributed to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding repeated wine-drinking offenses. It presents an escalating punishment for drinking khamr, placing the report within the domain of judicial rulings and the enforcement of halal and haram.
